decisions.reason: As a low-cost, adjacent dental consumables line that survived the initial post-launch period, it still preserves option value and fits the firm's digital and laboratory workflow focus.
This thermoforming blank closely matches the firm's established dental materials business, so keeping it open is inexpensive relative to the information and cross-selling value it provides.
The lacquer appears more peripheral and less prominently marketed than the core blanks, but as a complementary accessory it is still cheap enough to retain while demand potential remains uncertain.

Custom hearing protection earmolds build directly on the firm's hearing-care customization capabilities, making them a strategically coherent option that is worth continuing unless demand clearly disappoints.
